indice.entradaTexto: A free people's school with no sign-up: a path, a class and a record of what you studied.
indice.quemFoiTexto: The person the School is named after.
indice.cursosTexto: The courses of the Lúcia Maria School, built from the lessons on this site.
indice.matriculaTexto: Enrolment without an account: the number and your answers stay on your device only.
indice.calendarioTexto: The School's terms, exam weeks and holidays.
indice.campusTexto: The map of the School: where each part of the site is.
indice.turmasTexto: Studying together, as a class, with a sequence of lessons.
indice.acompanhanteTexto: Help to study and clear up doubts.
indice.cadernetaTexto: The record of what you studied and did at the School, kept on your device.
indice.modoSeguroTexto: For people who study on a shared or monitored device: an Exit button that erases what the site stored and switches the page.

melhor.lead: Based on your question, start here:

voz.aviso: Your voice is transcribed by your browser's service (Google or Apple), not by the Institute. Nothing is recorded here.
voz.semPermissao: The browser did not allow the microphone. Allow it in the site settings or type your search.
voz.naoOuviu: Could not hear you. Try again, closer to the microphone.
voz.semRede: Voice search needs the internet. Please type your search.
voz.erro: Voice search did not work right now. Please type your search.

historico.lead: The pages you opened in the last 7 days, kept only on this device. Nothing goes to the Institute.
historico.descricao: The pages you saw this week, kept only on your device.
historico.convite: Would you like this device to remember the pages you saw this week? It stays here only.
historico.ligado: Done: from now on this device remembers this week's pages.
historico.vazio: No pages kept yet. As you browse, they will show up here.
historico.desligado: Remembering is off. When it is on, this device, and only this device, remembers the pages you saw in the last 7 days.
historico.desligou: Done: this device no longer remembers and the list was erased.
historico.seguro: Safe mode is on: nothing is kept in this tab.
historico.risco: On a device someone else uses, this list shows what you studied. If that is a risk, leave it off or use safe mode.
historico.carregando: Reading what is stored on this device…

passos.p1Nivelamento: A few quick questions show where it is worth starting. It is not a test and there is no grade.
passos.p1Comecar: A short guide to choose your first subject.
passos.p2Texto: A short lesson to read at your own pace.
passos.p3: Come back here to see your progress
passos.p3Texto: What you study shows up here, kept only on this device.
passos.meuEstudo: You have not studied anything here yet. That's fine: start like this.
passos.praticar: There are no exercises to practise yet. They come with the lessons you do.
passos.turmas: You are not in any class yet. A class arrives through a link sent by whoever organises the study.
passos.caderno: The deck is empty. Cards come from what you highlight while reading and from the mistakes you save.
passos.erros: No mistakes saved. When you get a quiz question wrong, it shows up here to try again.

praticarAula.primeiro: First, the exercises from the lesson {aula}.
praticarAula.semExercicios: The lesson {aula} has no exercises with explanations. Choose others below or review the cards.
praticarAula.cartoes: Review the {n} cards from this lesson

seguro.sairRotulo: Exit now: erases what the site stored and switches the page
seguro.descricao: For people who study on a shared or monitored device: Exit button, Esc three times, and what the site can and cannot erase.
seguro.lead: For people who study on a shared or monitored phone. With safe mode on, an Exit button stays in the corner of the screen, and pressing Esc three times in a row also exits.
seguro.ligadoAgora: On in this tab. Closing the tab turns it off.
seguro.semSessao: This browser did not let safe mode turn on (the tab's storage is blocked).
seguro.faz2: Erases from this device everything the site stored: study, notebook, preferences and the pages saved for reading offline.
seguro.faz3: The voices downloaded to listen to lessons stay: they are the same files for everyone and say nothing about you.
seguro.faz4: Replaces this page with an ordinary weather-forecast search, without telling the other site where you came from.
seguro.faz5: The Back button does not return to the page you were on.
seguro.naoFaz1: Erase the browser history. The Institute pages you opened stay there, unless you use a private window.
seguro.naoFaz2: Hide what the network (home, school or work wi-fi) or the phone carrier has already seen.
seguro.naoFaz3: Protect the device from spyware installed on it.
seguro.naoFaz4: If you are on the team and use the panel's encrypted conversations on this device, the exit also erases their keys. You will need to approve the device again; if it is the only approved one, old conversations may become unreadable.
seguro.anonimaLead: In a private window, the browser keeps no history and nothing from the site after you close it. It is the safest way to study on a monitored device.
seguro.anonima1: Chrome or Edge on a computer: Ctrl + Shift + N.
seguro.anonima2: Firefox on a computer: Ctrl + Shift + P.
seguro.anonima3: Safari on a Mac: Command + Shift + N.
seguro.anonima4: Chrome on a phone: in the three-dot menu, tap New Incognito tab.
seguro.anonima5: Safari on an iPhone: tap the tabs button and choose Private.
seguro.antesLead: The exit erases the study stored on this device. If you want to keep it, download a copy first. The file goes to your downloads folder: keep it somewhere safe.
seguro.semEstudo: There is no study stored on this device to copy.
seguro.ajuda: Help phone lines, such as the Women's Assistance Centre, are in the rights guide.
